bank.s: 現在完成式的句型結構是？
o: be 動詞 + 現在分詞
bank.e: 現在完成式＝have / has + 過去分詞 (p.p.)。主詞是第三人稱單數用 has，其餘用 have。

bank.s: She ___ been a singer for ten years.
bank.e: 主詞 She 是第三人稱單數，用 has + p.p.。

bank.s: eat 的三態變化是？
bank.e: eat - ate - eaten，是 A-B-C 型不規則變化。

bank.s: go 的過去分詞是？
bank.e: go - went - gone。

bank.s: 下列哪一組動詞三態「完全相同」？
bank.e: cut、put、read 三態同形（read 的讀音會變：[rid] - [rεd] - [rεd]）。

bank.s: do 的過去分詞是？
bank.e: do - did - done。

bank.s: be 動詞的過去分詞是？
bank.e: be - was / were - been。

bank.s: see 的過去分詞是？
bank.e: see - saw - seen。

bank.s: 下列哪一組是 A-B-A 型（原形與過去分詞相同）？
bank.e: become - became - become、come - came - come、run - ran - run 都是原形與過去分詞同形。

bank.s: stop 的過去分詞是？
bank.e: 短母音＋單子音結尾要重複字尾再加 -ed：stop - stopped - stopped，同類還有 mop、plan。

bank.s: study 的過去分詞是？
bank.e: 子音＋y 結尾，去 y 加 -ied：study - studied - studied，同類還有 cry、try。

bank.s: bring 的過去分詞是？
bank.e: bring - brought - brought，屬 A-B-B 型，同類還有 hear - heard - heard、make - made - made。

bank.s: 「I have」的縮寫是？
bank.e: I have = I've，we have = we've，you have = you've，they have = they've。

bank.s: 「he has」的縮寫是？
bank.e: he has = he's，she has = she's。注意 he's 也可能是 he is，要看後面接的詞判斷。

bank.s: 「has not」的縮寫是？
bank.e: have not = haven't，has not = hasn't。

bank.s: 下列句子何者「正確」？
bank.e: She 用 has，後面要接過去分詞 finished。

bank.s: A: ___ you ever made candy apples before?　B: Yes, I have.
bank.e: 問經驗用 Have + 主詞 + ever + p.p.？

bank.s: A: Has Jenny ever ___ pumpkin pies before?　B: No, she hasn't.
bank.e: 疑問句 Has + 主詞 + ever + 過去分詞。bake - baked - baked。

bank.s: A: Have you ever seen snow before?　B: Yes, we have. We ___ snow once.
bank.e: 主詞 We 用 have + 過去分詞 seen。once 表示「一次」，是經驗的次數。

bank.s: No, she hasn't. She ___ pumpkin pies before.
bank.e: 否定的經驗用 have / has + never + p.p.，never 本身就有否定的意思，不再加 not。

bank.s: A: Have Susan and Jack ever tried chocolate eggs?　B: Yes, they ___.
bank.e: 主詞 Susan and Jack 是複數，簡答用 Yes, they have.。

bank.s: They have tried chocolate eggs ___ (很多次).
bank.e: many times 很多次，用來表示經驗的次數。

bank.s: A: Have you ever been to a night market?　B: Yes, I have. I ___ to a night market many times.
bank.e: have been to 表示「曾經去過（已回來）」，是經驗用法；have gone to 是「去了還沒回來」。

bank.s: A: Have you ever spoken English on the phone?　B: No, I ___ English on the phone.
bank.e: 否定經驗：I have never spoken English on the phone.＝I've never spoken...

bank.s: Yes, I've been abroad ___. (只去過一次)
bank.e: once 一次；twice 兩次；three times 三次。

bank.s: 「ever」在現在完成式中通常用在？
bank.e: ever（曾經）多用於疑問句：Have you ever...?；否定句則用 never。

bank.s: 下列哪一句「錯誤」？
o: Have you ever read this book?
Has she ever been to the USA?
bank.e: ate 是過去式，現在完成式要用過去分詞 eaten：Have they ever eaten pizza?

bank.s: A: Has she ever read this book?　B: ___
bank.e: Has 開頭的問句，簡答用 Yes, she has. / No, she hasn't.。

bank.s: I ___ candy apples before. (我做過蘋果糖)
bank.e: make - made - made，I 用 have。

bank.s: 現在完成式可以用來表達的三種概念，「不包含」下列哪一項？
o: 已完成或尚未完成的動作
bank.e: 課本 Tips 指出現在完成式可表達：A 經驗、B 動作持續了一段時間、C 已完成或尚未完成的動作。

bank.s: A: ___ have you lived here?　B: I have lived here for ten years.
bank.e: 問「持續多久」用 How long + have / has + 主詞 + p.p.?

bank.s: I have lived here ___ ten years.
bank.e: for + 一段時間（ten years, a month, two hours）。

bank.s: She has been a singer ___ 2012.
bank.e: since + 時間點（2012, last year, she was a little girl）。

bank.s: She has been a singer ___ she was a little girl.
bank.e: since 後面也可以接一個過去式的子句，表示「自從…以來」。

bank.s: A: How long ___ Rick worked in the library?　B: He has worked there for a month.
bank.e: 主詞 Rick 是第三人稱單數，用 has。

bank.s: A: How long has Lisa been a cook?　B: She has been a cook ___ she was thirty years old.
bank.e: she was thirty years old 是一個時間點的子句，用 since。

bank.s: A: How long have they watched TV?　B: They have watched TV ___ two hours.
bank.e: two hours 是一段時間，用 for。

bank.s: A: How long have Jay and Cate been friends?　B: They have been friends ___ 2000.
bank.e: 2000 是一個年份（時間點），用 since。

bank.s: 下列哪一個「不能」接在 for 後面？
bank.e: last year 是時間點，要用 since；for 後面接一段時間長度。

bank.s: 下列哪一個「不能」接在 since 後面？
bank.e: ten years 是一段時間，要用 for。

bank.s: A: How long has Wendy been a singer?　B: ___
o: She is a singer for ten years.
She has been a singer for ten years.
She have been a singer for ten years.
bank.e: 持續到現在的狀態用 has been + for / since。

bank.s: 「我認識我最好的朋友五年了。」的英文是？
o: I know my best friend for five years.
I have known my best friend for five years.
I have known my best friend since five years.
I am knowing my best friend for five years.
bank.e: know - knew - known；五年是一段時間，用 for。

bank.s: Rick ___ in the library for a month.
bank.e: Rick 是第三人稱單數，用 has + worked。

bank.s: 問句「How long have you been in this school?」的正確回答是？
bank.e: How long 問持續多久，要用 for / since 回答。Yes/No 不能回答 How long 問句。

bank.s: A: Have you finished the housework ___?　B: No, I haven't.
bank.e: yet 用於疑問句與否定句，表示「已經／還（沒）」。

bank.s: I have ___ finished the housework. (我已經做完家事了)
bank.e: already（已經）用於肯定句。

bank.s: No, I haven't finished the housework ___.
bank.e: 否定句用 yet，放在句尾，表示「還沒」。

bank.s: A: ___ you eaten your breakfast?　B: Yes, and I have done the dishes.
bank.e: Have you eaten your breakfast? eat - ate - eaten。

bank.s: Yes, and I have ___ the dishes.
bank.e: do the dishes 洗碗；do 的過去分詞是 done。

bank.s: A: By the way, have you ___ packing yet?　B: No, I haven't packed yet.
bank.e: Have + 主詞 + p.p.：finish - finished - finished。finish 後面接動名詞 packing。

bank.s: No, I ___ packed yet.
bank.e: 否定的現在完成式：haven't + p.p.，句尾配 yet。

bank.s: I've already finished ___ the floor.
bank.e: finish 後面接動名詞 (V-ing)：finish cleaning the floor。

bank.s: already 通常放在句子的什麼位置？
o: have / has 與過去分詞之間
bank.e: I have already finished the housework.；yet 則放句尾。

bank.s: 下列哪一句「正確」？
o: I have already finish my homework.
I have finished my homework already.
I haven't finished my homework already.
I have yet finished my homework.
bank.e: already 可放在 have 與 p.p. 之間或句尾；否定句與疑問句要用 yet。

bank.s: 「你收拾好行李了嗎？」的英文是？
bank.e: Have you packed yet? pack - packed - packed。

bank.s: 下列哪一句表示「動作尚未完成」？
o: I have already cleaned the floor.
I haven't cleaned the floor yet.
bank.e: haven't + p.p. + yet 表示動作尚未完成。

bank.s: 「運動」的英文 exercise，當名詞時還可以指？
bank.e: exercise 當名詞可指「運動」或「習題」（可數），亦可當動詞。

bank.s: 「做運動」的正確說法是？
bank.e: do sports 或 play sports。

bank.s: 片語「fly a kite」的意思是？
bank.e: kite 風箏，fly a kite 放風箏。

bank.s: tooth 的複數形是？
bank.e: tooth（牙齒）的複數是 teeth，屬於不規則變化。

bank.s: 片語「lose face」的意思是？
bank.e: face 臉，lose face 丟臉。

bank.s: 諺語「Walls have ears.」的意思是？
bank.e: ear 耳朵，Walls have ears. 隔牆有耳。

bank.s: 片語「Break a leg!」是什麼意思？
bank.e: leg 腿，Break a leg! 是祝福別人演出順利、祝你好運的說法。

bank.s: 關於 homework 的用法，何者正確？
o: 不可數名詞，寫作業是 do one's homework
可數名詞，寫作業是 make homework
不可數名詞，寫作業是 write homework
bank.e: homework 是不可數名詞，沒有複數；「寫作業」是 do one's homework。

bank.s: 「一小時」的正確說法是？
bank.e: hour 的 h 不發音，字首發母音，所以用 an hour。

bank.s: 「淋浴」的正確片語是？
bank.e: shower 淋浴；陣雨。take a shower 淋浴。

bank.s: 關於 hair 的用法，下列何者正確？
o: 指全部頭髮時不可數，指一根或幾根時可數
bank.e: hair 指人全部的頭髮時為不可數名詞，但指一根或幾根頭髮則為可數名詞。白頭髮是 gray hair。

bank.s: 片語「keep an eye on...」的意思是？
bank.e: catch one's eye 吸引某人注意；keep an eye on... 照看、留意。

bank.s: 片語「pay lip service」的意思是？
bank.e: lip 嘴唇，pay lip service 光說不練、嘴上說說而已。

bank.s: 片語「take sides」的意思是？
bank.e: side 面；邊。take sides 支持一方、選邊站。

bank.s: 「手機」的英文是？
bank.e: telephone（=phone）是電話，「手機」是 cellphone。

bank.s: centimeter 的縮寫與中文意思是？
bank.e: centimeter（= cm）公分；height 是身高、高度。

bank.s: 片語「up in arms」的意思是？
bank.e: arm 手臂，up in arms 火冒三丈、非常憤怒。

bank.s: 片語「body language」的意思是？
bank.e: body 身體，body language 肢體語言。

bank.s: 片語「not on your life」的意思是？
bank.e: life 生命；生活；人生。not on your life 想都別想、絕對不行。
